_doc: THE GOLDEN FREEZE REGISTER — the one inventory of the same-seed golden estate.
WHAT THIS FILE IS. Every instrument that pins a same-seed fingerprint gets one row here,
identity-addressed (never index-addressed, never count-addressed). tests/lint/goldenFreeze.walker.test.js
walks this register on every gate run and convicts four ways: a manifest edited without its
register row, a register row edited without its manifest, a golden instrument in the tree with
neither a row nor a written exclusion, and a roster that has silently collapsed.
⛔ THIS REGISTER IS UNFROZEN. `frozenAt` is null, and so are `frozenAtSha` and `genesis`.
That is the CORRECT state before the TE-GOLDEN-1 freeze act. What exists today is the
MACHINERY: the roster inventory (which instruments exist, their env spellings, their record
paths, their constant-site counts) measured by execution at the build base. What does NOT
exist today is the RECORD: every `sha256`, `rows`, `seedSet`, `distinctFloor`,
`frozenConstants` and `ownerRow` is null and MUST stay null until the freeze act writes it
through the door. A lane that fills one of those fields has cut the record without the pen.
⛔ NEVER HAND-EDIT A MEASURED FIELD. Every figure here is an actual out of execution, written
by tests/helpers/goldenRecordDoor.js in the same atomic act that writes the fixture it
describes. A hand-composed hash is the 'stale numeral' class the walker exists to refuse.
The lighting census register (tests/lint/.lighting-census-baseline.json) is the model this
follows verbatim in spirit: measured fields are actuals, provenance is load-bearing, the
derivation history lives in the WALKER beside the assertions, and only the live values live here.
THE TRI-STATE CLOSURE. `frozenAt`, `frozenAtSha` and `genesis` are null together or set
together — the walker asserts it. A half-filled freeze (a genesis block written, a sha not,
or the reverse) is an interrupted act, and an interrupted act that reads as a complete one is
how a freeze certifies bytes nobody recorded.
HOW A ROW LAWFULLY MOVES (after the freeze act arms this register): through
tests/helpers/goldenRecordDoor.js and nowhere else, with GOLDEN_SHIFT_SIGNED naming a signed
shift-record FILE under docs/shift-records/ whose CONTENT the door parses and verifies. The
env var's presence is not armament; only the parsed record is. Each surface in that record
carries an `action` verb — `re-record` and `retire` are owner-signed (protection shrinks only
by the pen), `enroll` is chair-signed vetoably (protection only grows). A successful write
throws BY DESIGN so a re-record can never be mistaken for a passing gate; the plain re-run
afterwards is the receipt.
FIELD MEANINGS.
surface          stable identity. Never an index, never a position.
path             the bytes that carry the fingerprint (a manifest, or the suite itself for
an in-file-constant surface).
suite            the test file that asserts against `path`.
recordEnv        the env spelling this surface's capture arm honors, or null where the
surface has no capture arm (a hand-maintained manifest, a vitest snapshot,
an in-file constant). null is a CLAIM, not an absence — see `note`.
proofForm        what a signed record must prove against for this surface, per ODQ §555.8.
Filled at the freeze act; a map-family surface may not prove with a
settlement-record hash.
sha256           BYTES of `path`, not normalized content — a whitespace-only edit convicts.
rows             a cheap closure check independent of the hash.
seedSet          declared so seed EROSION is visible: a re-record that quietly drops a seed
reds the closure check, not just the hash.
distinctFloor    the frozen discrimination figure. 'nonzero' is abolished as a floor — the
estate's committed standard is the espionage fence's 360/360.
constantSites    for in-file-constant surfaces: how many 64-hex sites the extractor finds.
This is an INVENTORY figure and it is live TODAY — the walker asserts it
before the freeze, so a constant added or deleted convicts immediately.
ownerRow         the ODQ §-row where the owner signed this row's current bytes.
governance       present only where a surface's own header carries a seal STRONGER than
door traffic. Read it before ruling on that row.

inventory.note: ROSTER INVENTORY ONLY, measured by execution against the build base. No frozen value is recorded here and none may be until the freeze act. _doc: INSTRUMENTS THE ROSTER FOUND BUT CANNOT PLACE. Each needs a ruling at the freeze act:
a register row, or a written exclusion. Neither is a lane decision — a roster ruling is
the freeze act's. The walker asserts this list is EXACTLY what the tree still shows, so
an item cannot be resolved by forgetting it.

fixturelessDormancyGoldens.finding: 32 tests/property/*DormancyGolden.test.js suites exist. 26 read UPDATE_GOLDEN and own a tests/fixtures/*-dormancy-golden.json. The 27th fixture (route-network-dormancy-golden.json) belongs to tests/domain/routeNetworkDormancy.test.js, outside the *DormancyGolden naming shape. That leaves SIX suites named *DormancyGolden with NO manifest file and NO capture arm.
fixturelessDormancyGoldens.consequence: The charter's §1.1 row 5 prices the dormancy family as '32 suites, one register row EACH'. A register row's load-bearing fields are `path` + `sha256` — BYTES of a manifest. Six of the 32 have no manifest to hash, so six of those rows cannot be written as specified. They are either computed-in-file dormancy proofs that belong on the written exclusion roster with a proofForm of their own, or genuinely unfrozen same-seed instruments — the second-class path §1.3 exists to close.

surfaces.governance: Charter §1.1 row 15 / §1.1a. Its header carries a hand-maintained enumeration of chartered movement windows which the freeze act retires into one sentence. Implementation-leave: the fence itself is not rebuilt.

Header seal: 'Re-record it only with a stated, legitimate cause under the estate's golden-shift discipline, never to get green.' Compatible with door traffic. Inventoried by lane GOLDEN's own constant sweep at the build base; independently discovered by lane T13's step-5 fence sweep. It is NOT in the charter's §1.1 table.

OWNER STOP, NOT DOOR TRAFFIC. This suite's header reads, verbatim: '⛔ THIS NUMBER MOVING IS A STOP, NEVER A RE-RECORD — it is the owner's condition.' A register row is a re-recordable surface by construction, so enrolling this constant as ordinary door traffic would DOWNGRADE an owner STOP into a signed re-record. It is inventoried here so the freeze act cannot miss it; whether it is enrolled as door traffic, enrolled with a STOP flag the door honors, or excluded and left on its header seal is a GOVERNANCE RULING the freeze act must make explicitly.

surfaces.note: NO CAPTURE ARM EXISTS. interiorModel.test.js only READS this manifest; there is no writeFileSync and no env spelling anywhere in the suite, so this golden is re-recorded BY HAND under the SHIFT RECORD block in the suite's header. It is invisible to the env-pattern census AND to the tests/fixtures/*golden*.json glob (wrong directory), and is enrolled here solely because this row names its path. The door cannot migrate a capture arm that does not exist; the walker's byte arm is this surface's whole enforcement.

surfaces.governance: THE WRITER IS VITEST ITSELF, NOT REPO SOURCE. This surface is a vitest toMatchSnapshot() file; its lawful re-record path is `vitest -u`. That path carries no env spelling and no writeFileSync, so no source scan can see it and THE DOOR CANNOT REFUSE IT. The walker can only CONVICT the result after the fact via the byte arm. This asymmetry is real and is written here rather than discovered at the freeze: for this one surface the machinery detects but does not prevent. Ruling on whether to convert it to a door-written manifest belongs to the freeze act.
surfaces.note: Charter §1.1 row 6. The only __snapshots__ file in the estate.

NO CAPTURE ARM EXISTS, AND THAT IS THE POINT. This is the estate's only bit-level witness of WHICH simulation preset a NEW CAMPAIGN is born with: every other pulse and dormancy golden drives literal rules, so lighting the shipped default — or silently re-darkening it later — is invisible to all of them. The manifest records, per preset plus a `__birth_default__` row born through the real birth door with no preset id, the resolved birth rules and the hashes of one simulated year (52 interior one-week ticks). It carries no env spelling and no writeFileSync: the door writes recorded values onto these rows, and every such value must stay null until the freeze act, so a capture arm routed through the door today would poison this register. Re-recorded BY HAND under the golden-shift discipline, from the recipe in the manifest's own _doc, which drives tests/simulation/presetLightingWitnessRun.js — the single writer of the measurement, imported by the suite so the recorded world and the asserted world cannot diverge. The path is deliberately named `-golden` so arm 2's tests/fixtures/*golden*.json glob claims it: a witness named outside that glob would be enrolled only by this lane's good faith, and a later deletion of this row would red nothing. Enrolled by lane LGT-P14-WITNESS (seat Opus 5 — Fable-unvalidated) in the same commit that minted the surface. When the freeze act arms this register, its re-record path becomes the door like every other.
